constitutional_note: §3 requires an override to be explicit; §9.4 requires it to be durable. The engine did not weaken a gate (§13.7), did not invent a project fact (§13.3), and did not silently exceed a logged scope. The gate blocked, a human overrode it, and the override is scoped, logged, marked and reversible. That sequence is the system working as designed.
